assumptionsAndLimits: START-B compared 50 Gy in 25 fractions over five weeks with 40 Gy in 15 fractions over three weeks after primary surgery for early breast cancer. Icons count fractions and do not represent dose or calendar days. This is a 2013 trial-report illustration, not a replacement plan.
